## OWN-01 Opened milk for coffee
Kind: additional
Hazard: Milk going off once the carton has been opened.
Control: Write the date on each carton when it is opened, and keep open cartons in the drinks fridge.
Limit: Use by the end of the day after the carton is opened.
Limit-source: The dairy's label says to use opened milk within 2 days; our own rule is shorter.
Check: Staff check the dates on open cartons during the opening checks.
If-it-fails: Throw the milk away and write it in the diary.
Supplied-text:
EH-review:
State: confirmed
By: Priya Shah
On: 2026-11-20

## OWN-02 Sous vide eggs
Kind: special-process
Hazard: Harmful bacteria in eggs surviving if they are not cooked as the method says.
Control: We cook sous vide eggs only by our written method, below.
Limit:
Limit-source:
Check: Each morning the water bath's own thermometer is checked against the probe thermometer.
If-it-fails: Eggs not cooked by the method are thrown away, and the water bath is not used until it is checked.
Supplied-text: Our sous vide egg method, written with our equipment supplier.
  We cook British Lion eggs in their shells, in a covered water bath.
  The bath is set and checked to the time and temperature in the supplier's instructions before any eggs go in.
  Eggs are served straight away and never kept for later.
EH-review: pending
State: confirmed
By: Sam Okafor
On: 2026-11-20
